```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(1236)
```

## Mean and SD

check CLT using simulation.

```{r}
source("source/sim_mean_and_sd.R")
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
```


```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000){
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
```

```{r}
output |>
  bind_rows() |>
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |>
  bind_rows() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

Let's do this using tibbles and maps instead.

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |>
  unnest(est_df)
```

look at results.

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## change `n`

```{r cache=TRUE}
sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  )|>
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |>
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  )|>
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  )|>
  group_by(samp_size) |>
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean))

```


## SLR

generate once

```{r}
sim_data = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30,1,1),
    y = 2 + 3 * x + rnorm(30,0,1)
  )
sim_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

fit = lm(y ~x, data = sim_data)

fit
```

turn it into a function

```{r}
source("source/sim_slr.R")
sim_slr(30)
```

```{r}
slr_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30,1000)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |>
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
slr_results_df |>
  summarize(
    b0_mean = mean(beta0_hat),
    b0_se = sd(beta0_hat)
  )
```

```{r}
slr_results_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat)) +
  geom_density()
```

## birthday problem

```{r}
birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5
```

```{r}
source("source/birthday_repeated.R")

birthday_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 5:50,
    iter = 1:1000
  )|>
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people,birthday_repeated)
    )
```

```{r}
birthday_results_df |>
  group_by(number_of_people) |>
  summarize(prob_of_repeated = mean(repeated)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
```
